protocol.estimated_motion: local 5x5 patch correspondence with center-colour anchoring, forward/backward consistency, confidence and cost rejection
protocol.time_shuffled_control: first frame paired with an unrelated future frame

interpretation: A single pair of consecutive RGB frames is usually enough to estimate common fate and write a continuous pair-affinity relation that survives after motion stops and the objects relocate. Oracle flow closes the remaining gap, localizing failures to correspondence or pair-memory noise. Time shuffling destroys the evidence and returns to the static fragmented baseline.
